title: Massive fire guts large part of Subic Freeport factory

blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY -The fire that broke out at the Subic Bay Freeport Zone on Wednesday night gutted a large part of Jinboway Technology Ltd. Corporation inside the Subic Gateway Park, the Inquirer learned. The fire, which was the biggest in recent years inside the Freeport, started at 10:45 pm on Wednesday and lasted past 6 am on Thursday (November 5). Jinboway produces outdoor and travel products such as backpacks and other outdoor gear for international brands, including Yeti.
